prompt: Create an original 60 second Chinese chamber instrumental instrumental composition for celebration, positive conclusion and project reveal. Mood: hopeful, joyful, uplifting. Instruments: guzheng, xiao, soft wooden percussion. Style: pentatonic melodic arcs, plucked ornament and spacious breath. Tempo approximately 82 BPM; C major. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Introduce a memorable rising motif, develop it, and end with a confident resolved cadence. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A gentle and reflective instrumental piece featuring a prominent flute melody over a backdrop of pizzicato and bowed strings, creating a serene and slightly melancholic atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首温柔而富有沉思的器乐作品，以悠扬的长笛旋律为主，衬以拨弦和弓弦乐器，营造出宁静而略带忧郁的氛围。
